short: Good reduction for CM elliptic curves from Artin reciprocity

lean.name: GlobalTheory.Corev.CmTwoClosing.cmGoodModel_of_globalArtinReciprocity
lean.plain: Good reduction for CM elliptic curves from Artin reciprocity
lean.note: Global Artin reciprocity supplies the ideal class for the good-model argument. The resulting Weierstrass model has integral rescaled invariants and unit discriminant, so the theta kernel can be studied at good reduction.
